routes.name: Tank Bund Road
routes.blurb: The classic drive along the east bank of Hussain Sagar, past the lake and its row of statues.

routes.name: Necklace Road
routes.blurb: A sweeping lakeside loop around the west and north shores of Hussain Sagar.

routes.name: Charminar and Pathergatti
routes.blurb: Up Charminar Road, round the Charminar itself, then north along the bustling Pathergatti Road.

routes.name: Cyber Towers to Jubilee Hills
routes.blurb: From Cyber Towers past Inorbit Mall, across the Durgam Cheruvu cable bridge and along Road No. 36 to Jubilee Hills Checkpost.

routes.name: Banjara Hills Road No. 1
routes.blurb: Uphill from Masab Tank along Road No. 1, one of the city’s busiest arterials.
